oda-dac1.description: Context for working with the OECD DAC1 table, the donor-level totals of ODA, OOF, export credits and private flows by aid type. Covers who reports, the flow types (grant equivalent, net and gross disbursements, commitments) and price bases, what the ODA total includes (in-donor costs and core multilateral contributions), private sector instruments, ODA/GNI, and the double-counting traps with donor aggregates, EU Institutions, nested aid-type lines and memo items. Load once DAC1 has been chosen for an analysis, or when working with DAC1 figures. For choosing between DAC datasets, use oda-dataset-selection.
oda-dac1.name: oda-dac1

oda-dataset-selection.description: Context for choosing the dataset that answers an ODA or development finance question. Summarises what each dataset covers, which breakdowns each supports, and how their totals relate.
oda-dataset-selection.name: oda-dataset-selection

oda-measures.description: How the OECD DAC measures and reports ODA. Covers the flow types (gross disbursements, net disbursements, grant equivalents, and commitments) and which questions each fits, current and constant prices, DAC deflators and base years, and the 2018 switch to the grant-equivalent headline. Also covers how grants, concessional loans, and private sector instruments (PSI) qualify as ODA and are counted, including grant elements, discount rates, additionality, the institutional and instrument approaches, PSI transition arrangements, and the policy debate on loan and PSI measurement. Relevant to choosing a measure, comparing ODA across donors or years, explaining what an ODA figure represents, and assessing how a financing instrument counts in ODA.
oda-measures.name: oda-measures
